The '''MD-11 medical droid''' was a type of medical [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. Two were in use at the [[Aurora Medical Facility]] on [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]] in [[43 ABY]], where they were used to help raise the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Tobb Jadak]] out of a coma.
